inputs.ref_text: Meet Osteon, your anatomy study space. Rotate a real three-dimensional skeleton, explore its landmarks, and turn a study break into practice.

inputs.target_text: Your next anatomy exam deserves more than flat diagrams. Meet Oss-tee-on: a free study space that makes anatomy click.
inputs.instruct: Warm, lively, conversational female narration. Confident and inviting, with clear phrasing and natural emphasis. A brisk but comfortable tutorial pace. Clean studio voice.
